token.label: Front API Token
token.description: Your Front API token. You can create one from your Front settings under "Developers". Ensure the token has the necessary scopes.

addComment.label: Add Comment
addComment.description: Add a comment (internal note) to a conversation in Front.

addContactHandle.label: Add Contact Handle
addContactHandle.description: Add a handle (email, phone number, etc.) to an existing Contact.

handle_value.label: Handle Value
handle_value.description: The value of the handle (e.g., email address, phone number).

addContactHandle.afterResponse: return {success: true, message: 'Handle added successfully to ' + inputs.contact_id};

addConversationLinks.label: Add Conversation Links
addConversationLinks.description: Link external references (URLs) to a conversation.
addConversationLinks.afterResponse: return {success: true, message: 'Links added to conversation ' + inputs.conversation_id + ' successfully'};

addConversationTags.label: Add Conversation Tags
addConversationTags.description: Add one or more tags to a conversation.
addConversationTags.afterResponse: return {success: true, message: 'Tags added to conversation ' + inputs.conversation_id + ' successfully'};

assignUnassignConversation.label: Assign/Unassign Conversation
assignUnassignConversation.description: Assign a conversation to a teammate or remove assignment.
assignUnassignConversation.afterResponse: return {success: true, message: 'Conversation ' + inputs.conversation_id + ' assignee changed successfully'};

createAccount.label: Create Account
createAccount.description: Create a new account in Front.

name.label: Account Name
name.description: The name of the account to create.

domains.label: Domains
domains.description: List of domains associated with the account.

external_id.label: External ID
external_id.description: An external identifier for the account.

custom_fields.label: Custom Fields
custom_fields.description: Custom fields for this account, as a JSON object.

createContact.label: Create Contact
createContact.description: Create a new contact in Front.

handles.label: Handles
handles.description: List of contact handles (e.g., email, phone).

links.label: Links
links.description: List of URLs associated with the contact.

group_names.label: Group Names
group_names.description: List of group names to associate with the contact.

list_names.label: Contact Lists
list_names.description: List of contact list names this contact belongs to. Front will create any that do not exist.

custom_fields.label: Custom Fields
custom_fields.description: Custom fields for this contact, as a JSON object (e.g., {"CRM ID": "12345"}).

createDraft.label: Create Draft
createDraft.description: Create a draft message in Front.

to.label: To
to.description: List of recipient handles (email addresses, etc.).

body.label: Body
body.description: The body of the draft message.

signature_id.label: Signature ID
signature_id.description: The ID of the signature to use for the draft reply (if applicable).

should_add_default_signature.label: Add Default Signature
should_add_default_signature.description: Whether to append the default signature to the draft reply (if applicable).

createDraftReply.label: Create Draft Reply
createDraftReply.description: Create a draft reply to an existing conversation (subject/quote etc.) without sending immediately.

body.label: Message Body
body.description: The content of the draft reply.

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: The subject of the draft reply (for email channels).

to.label: To
to.description: List of recipient handles (email addresses, etc.).

signature_id.label: Signature ID
signature_id.description: The ID of the signature to use for the draft reply (if applicable).

should_add_default_signature.label: Add Default Signature
should_add_default_signature.description: Whether to append the default signature to the draft reply (if applicable).

createLink.label: Create Link
createLink.description: Create a Link in Front (name, external URL).

external_url.label: External URL
external_url.description: The external URL for the link.

findAccount.label: Find Account
findAccount.description: List company accounts and optionally filter by email domain or external ID.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to return (max 100).

sort_by.label: Sort By
sort_by.description: Field used to sort the accounts.

sort_order.label: Sort Order
sort_order.description: Order by which results should be sorted.

findConversation.label: Find Conversation
findConversation.description: Find a conversation by search filters such as subject, participants, tags, inbox, etc.

q.label: Query
q.description: Front query string (e.g. subject:"Order", tag_ids:tag_123, inbox_id:inb_456, etc.). See https://dev.frontapp.com/docs/search-1

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to return.

sendMessage.label: Send Message
sendMessage.description: Send a new message (starts a conversation) with subject, recipients, body, tags, etc.

to.label: To
to.description: List of recipient handles (email addresses, etc.).

sendReply.label: Send Reply
sendReply.description: Send a reply to a conversation in Front.

body.label: Message Body
body.description: The content of the reply message.

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: The subject of the reply (for email channels).

to.label: To
to.description: List of recipient handles (email addresses, etc.).

updateAccount.label: Update Account
updateAccount.description: Update an existing account in Front.

name.label: Account Name
name.description: The new name for the account.

description.label: Description
description.description: The new description for the account.

domains.label: Domains
domains.description: List of domains associated with the account.

custom_fields.label: Custom Fields
custom_fields.description: Custom fields to add or update. Existing fields will be preserved.

updateContact.label: Update Contact
updateContact.description: Update an existing contact in Front.

name.label: Name
name.description: The new name for the contact.

description.label: Description
description.description: A new description for the contact.

avatar_url.label: Avatar URL
avatar_url.description: URL of the contact’s avatar image.

links.label: Links
links.description: List of URLs associated with the contact.

updateContact.afterResponse: return {success: true, message: 'Contact ' + inputs.contact_id + ' updated successfully'};

updateConversation.label: Update Conversation
updateConversation.description: Modify conversation properties: status, assignee, inbox, tags, etc.

status.label: Status
status.description: The new status for the conversation.

updateConversation.afterResponse: return {success: true, message: 'Conversation ' + inputs.conversation_id + ' updated successfully'};

updateLink.label: Update Link
updateLink.description: Update the name or external URL of a Link in Front.

name.label: Name
name.description: The new name for the link.

external_url.label: External URL
external_url.description: The new external URL for the link.

updateLink.afterResponse: return {success: true, message: 'Link ' + inputs.link_id + ' updated successfully'};

findContact.label: Find Contact
findContact.description: Look up a contact by handle (email, phone, etc.) or other identifying field.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return.

newComment.label: New Comment

inbox_id.label: Inbox ID
inbox_id.description: The ID of the inbox to monitor for new inbound messages.
